_policy.india: Title = 'LifeX Food Scanner: ' + the native word printed on pack ingredient panels. English keywords (food, scanner) stay in Latin script because Indian Play users mostly type English queries; the native word keeps the listing local. Short/full description stay native; full description opens with one English sentence carrying the core search terms.
_policy.native_search: JP, CN, TW, KR, TH, VI, AR, RU and European/SEA Latin-script locales: users search in their own language, so the title stays native but uses the term people actually search (e.g. 'scanner alimentaire', 'escáner de alimentos', 'Проверка состава').
